terminal.bar.ago: You took over {n} min ago. Messages to this AI are queued until you hand back.
terminal.bar.connecting.body: Waiting for a direct connection to this computer.
terminal.bar.ended.body: The interactive session ended and control returned to the AI.
terminal.bar.missing.body: This AI member has not been read yet or has left the group.
terminal.bar.now: You took over just now. Messages to this AI are queued until you hand back.
terminal.bar.offline.body: Cannot reach this AI's computer right now.
terminal.bar.relay.body: The terminal works over a direct connection only. Establish one to this computer first.
terminal.bar.relayed.body: The connection switched to a relay, so the terminal closed and handed back to the AI.
terminal.bar.starting.body: Switching the AI session into interactive terminal mode.
terminal.error.busy: This AI is busy with another terminal or a merge right now.
terminal.error.cli: The AI CLI could not open the interactive session on its computer.
terminal.error.conflict: This session cannot be taken over in its current state.
terminal.error.home_unreachable: The AI's computer cannot reach this group's home right now.
terminal.error.not_found: This AI or task was not found on its computer.
terminal.hint.branch: Code changed here stays on the task branch and goes through checks, review and merge as usual.
terminal.hint.newTask: Opening the terminal of an AI without a task creates one so changes stay on a task branch.
terminal.hint.secretary: The secretary's session is read-only and changes no files.
terminal.note.privacy: SoloDawn does not read what is in the terminal. When you hand back, a summary is posted to the thread with what was asked, which files changed, and what was committed.
terminal.note.relay.body: When this computer uses a relay, Open terminal is disabled until a direct connection is established.
terminal.note.relay.lead: The terminal works over a direct connection only.
terminal.queue.body: Messages sent to this AI during the takeover are delivered in order when you hand back.
terminal.queue.title: Queued messages
terminal.title: Terminal
